email_draft.subject: Anita, Marcus Hill thought we should talk | Journify
email_draft.body:
Marcus Hill at Newark Public Schools passed your name along on April 9, and mentioned you've had real frustrations with your current SPED vendor.

NJ's IEP rates are among the highest in the country, which means your case managers and therapists are already carrying a heavier documentation load than most. Journify sits on top of your existing IEP system and gives the whole team, teachers, paraprofessionals, and related-service providers, a shared place to draft IEP materials, track progress, and generate instructional supports. Most teams cut paperwork time roughly in half, which puts afternoons back where they belong.

Open to a 20-minute conversation this week or next so I can hear what's not working and show you what Marcus's team is doing differently?
